    Graded k(P)-modules as representations of pieces of the cover #

    For a graded k(P)-module M (grading rayGrAlg ℓ k), the cover object a = (y, u) corresponds to the degree g(a) = u ≫ (ℓ y)⁻¹ (gOf), and W a = e_y M_{g(a)} is the space of M "at a". A ray f : y ⟶ z lifted at a maps W a into W b for the target b of the lift (gOf_target). This gives a representation grRep S of the piece D_S for every finite set S of cover objects.
